newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai stocks rise, end above key 600-point level.
newsitem.headline: Thai stocks rise, end above key 600-point level.

text.p: After six days of declines, Thai stocks ended in the black for the second time in 16 trading days on Tuesday as bargain hunters snapped up cheap blue-chip shares, brokers said.
The SET index rose 8.06 points or 1.36 percent to end above the psychological 600-point level at 600.24 on 4.16 billion baht trade. The SET-50 index was up 1.06 points to 44.30.
"We all know the shares are very low already. So investors may think today is a good time to buy," said one broker at Wall Street Finance.
Gainers led losers 192 to 130 with 73 unchanged.
